content: Hi! How can I help you with the reunion photos or videos today?
Hey! Could you send me the album link? I want to go through the group shots and maybe grab a few originals.
Absolutely! I've just finished uploading everything to our shared folder: <reunion_album_link>. Feel free to browse around, it's organized by day and activity.
This looks awesome. Some of the photos download as HEIC and I can't open them on my laptop. Any chance you have JPG versions?
Great catch! I've added a 'JPG' versions folder for easy access. Just click into that section, and you should be able to download any photo you like without compatibility issues.
Perfect, thanks! Also, are the videos full resolution? I want to save the dance montage for offline viewing.
They are! If you'd like, I can export all videos as a ZIP file so you can quickly download them for offline playback. Would you like me to prep that for you?
Yes, please! That would make it so much easier.
Done! You'll find a 'Videos (Full-Quality).zip' in the folder. Just click to download, and you can watch anytime, even without Wi-Fi.
Amazing. I noticed a few pictures of folks who might not want their photos shared. Should I check with them first before downloading or printing?

That's very thoughtful of you! It's best to double-check with anyone who appears in group photos you want to share or print. If you need me to add view-only permissions for certain images, just let me know.
Thanks for being careful with privacy. Everything is so well-organized! Do you have any tips for keeping my favorite shots sorted once I download them?
Of course! After you download, you could make folders by event, or tag each file name with who's in the photo or where it was taken. It makes finding memories later much easier.
That's super helpful. I'll get started on downloads now. Thanks again for putting this together!
You're so welcome, I loved reliving those moments while organizing everything. Let me know if you need any more files or help with formats. Enjoy your albums!
